dateAssessment: Working campaign calendar: June 8–13, 1749, from the session YAML only. The transcript gives no civil date or clock. Its three or four nights of eastward travel, two later sleeps, roughly half a day and shorter intervals cannot independently verify five calendar transitions; the time extraction is compatible, not matched. The opening Sunwine Hall stay is prior-session recap, not two newly played days. The sun’s position changes with geography and supplies no civil watch. Open rows below preserve actual elapsed-time evidence without assigning unknown activity to an invented watch. The final proposed long rest is replaced by a short rest; the earlier Prayer of Healing takes ten minutes and grants benefits without adding an hour. Focused transcript handoffs confirm these endpoints: session 120 ends on leaving Sunwine Hall (u2158–u2178), and session 122 resumes outside the darkness (u0002–u0026); neither supplies a civil clock.

watches.summary: Three or four nights of sleep precede arrival at the Sunset Gate; no civil watch is anchored.
The travelers sleep, eat and sleep again before the borderlands; elapsed time remains uncertain.
About half a day passes before the low hills and giant toll collectors.
A few hours, loosely suggested as three, five or seven, precede sighting the hunters.
About 45 minutes of flight precede slowing down to engage the hunters.
Wellby takes a few minutes to catch and remount the still-running wyvern.
Delwath’s ten-minute Prayer of Healing overlaps Seeker’s study; awarded rest benefits add no separate hour.
An unmeasured travel interval passes after the ten-minute stop, until hunger returns.
An actual short rest and meal pass; use the one-hour rest convention.
An unmeasured flight after crossing the river ends a few miles outside the darkness.
